description: Validates the six Consumer/Host app targets across entrypoints, Firebase registrations, Apple schemes and entitlements, Android flavors and capabilities, deep links, force-update policy, and fastlane release ownership (Mobile Beta, Mobile Production, fastlane/Fastfile).

rules.title: Installable app identity resolves from one checked target contract
rules.instruction: Consumer and Host are separate installable products. Entrypoints, native ids and capabilities, Firebase registrations, links, force-update keys, routine release ownership, and enabled release-critical callable dependencies must match checked target contracts. A production client feature cannot be enabled until its callable export and live Firebase callable/IAM reachability pass the release preflight; temporary release exceptions require a stable debt id and explicit removal proof.
